1.why: All MFA endpoints use authorized(), which binds the session cookie to session.userId and loads that user; no client-supplied user id is trusted.

2.why: Identity OTPs are stored on the session, TOTP is verified against the authenticated user’s decrypted secret, and backup codes are checked only on that user’s hashes—so codes do not work for other users.

3.why: mfa/activate only sets mfa.enabled and issues backups; it does not invalidate or re-auth other existing sessions in the sessions Map.

4.why: OTP secret is stored as AES-GCM encryptedSecret; backup codes are stored as salt plus SHA-256 hash, not plaintext.

5.why: token(), secret(), identityCode(), and recoveryCode() all use crypto.getRandomValues (Web Crypto CSPRNG).

6.why: Session id is only in an HttpOnly cookie; client script keeps csrf/provision in memory and never writes secrets/OTPs/tokens to localStorage, sessionStorage, or non-HttpOnly cookies.

7.why: Server validates email, phone, OTP, recovery, CSRF, and manualSecret with strict regex/type checks before use.

8.why: Client render path runs dynamic values through esc() which HTML-encodes &, <, >, ", and ' before innerHTML.

9.why: Only redirect is a fixed 308 from HTTP to https://localhost:3000/; no user-controlled redirect targets exist.

10.why: secureHeaders/pageResponse set CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, and X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors DENY/none.

11.why: cookie() sets mfa_session with HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Strict.

12.why: Errors are generic and tokens are not in URLs, but the UI intentionally console-logs and displays identity codes, test OTPs, and backup codes in a logs panel.

13.why: Identity codes expire in 5 minutes and set identityUsed; TOTP rejects reused verifiedCounter window; backup codes flip used after success.

14.why: Identity, TOTP, and recovery each increment failure counters and lock for LOCK_MS after MAX_FAILURES (5).

15.why: New session id on sign-in and after identity; idle/absolute timeouts enforced in authorized(); logout deletes the session and clears the cookie.
